title: data-augmentation-project
summary: A Jupyter notebook pipeline that generates synthetic IoMT/health-sensor data (ECU_IoHT dataset) for augmentation and downstream model training. It defines multiple synthetic data generation techniques and evaluates their quality, running SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and CTGANSynthesizer along with evaluate_quality to produce and score the augmented datasets.
